The '''Krakana underwater fighter''' was a vessel employed by the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] for use in combat against [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWL32" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Krakanafighter.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Krakana fighters defend Calamari refugees.]]

The Krakana was a one-man fighter for use in the waters of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] resembling a sea creature with a large tailfin for propulsion and four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] shaped like pincers. The craft was armed with six laser cannons, two near the center of the ship, and four others attached to the limbs stretching off the sides of the craft.<ref name="SWL32" /> They were named after the deadly [[Krakana/Legends|Krakana]], an aquatic predator on the world,<ref name="DarkApprentice">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> and at least one of the craft had a drawing of the predator on the underside of its hull.<ref name="SWL32" />

==History==
These vessels were used to protect [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees who were being systematically [[Skirmish on Dac|hunted down]] by [[Darth Krayt]]'s forces as part of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] plot to [[Genocide on Dac|eliminate]] the Mon Calamari people. The Mon Calamari Rangers met the Imperials' [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark]] fighters in direct combat with these craft, allowing Mon Calamari civilians to escape destruction.<ref name="SWL32" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krakana underwater fighters first appeared in [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']], a [[2009]] story arc in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]]. It was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Omar Francia]].
